guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: Checkoutservice latency percentiles spiked dramatically (+1761% p50, +1943% p90) alongside increased socket and memory metrics, indicating internal resource exhaustion. This bottleneck caused frontend requests to timeout and error, as shown by the massive frontend_error z-score and trace failures originating in frontendservice.

proposed_fix.description: Increase checkoutservice connection pool limits or scale horizontally to prevent socket exhaustion and reduce request latency.
